text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perlembagaan Persekutuan
(Kajian Semula Pemberian Khas di bawah Perkara 112D) (Negeri Sabah) 2023.

Pemberian khas

2. (1) Bagi tempoh enam tahun berkuat kuasa mulai 1 Januari 2022,
Kerajaan Persekutuan hendaklah membuat kepada Negeri Sabah, berkenaan dengan
tahun kewangan 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026 dan 2027, pemberian masing-masing

berjumlah RM125.6 juta, RM300 juta, RM306  juta, RM312 juta, RM318 juta dan
RM325 juta.

(2) Kerajaan Persekutuan telah membuat kepada Negeri Sabah,
berkenaan dengan tahun kewangan 2022, pemberian berjumlah RM125.6  juta
pada 16 Jun 2022.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Perlembagaan Persekutuan  (Kajian Semula Pemberian Khas di b awah
Perkara 112D) (Negeri Sabah) 2022 [P.U. (A) 119/2022] dibatalkan.

Dibuat 22 November 2023
[MOF.NBO(R)600-8/4/1 JLD.3(5); PN(PU2)171/XXV]

 Dengan Titah Perintah

        ANWAR BIN IBRAHIM
     Menteri Kewangan

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION (REVIEW OF SPECIAL GRANT UNDER ARTICLE 112D)
(STATE OF SABAH) ORDER 2023

WHEREAS by virtue of Clause (1) of Article 112 D of the Federal Constitution,
the special grant made to the State of Sabah as specified in paragraph (a) Clause (1)
of Article 112 C of the Federal Constitution shall be reviewed by the Governments of
the Federation and the State of Sabah;

AND WHEREAS the review was held by the Governments of the Federation and
the State of Sabah on 23 June 2023;

AND WHEREAS the said review has resulted in the Governments of the Federation
and the State of Sabah agreeing that for the period of six years wi th effect
from 2022 to 2027 made under Clause (3) of Article 112 D of the Federal Constitution ,
the Government of the Federation shall make to the Government of the State of Sabah,
in respect of each financial year, another grant instead of the grant mad e under
the Federal Constitution (Review of Special Grant under Article 112 D) (State of Sabah)
Order 2022 [P.U. (A) 119/2022];

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by Clause (1) of Article 112 D
of the Federal Constitution, the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:
